senses.sense_definition: A psychological operation, especially a covert operation intended to influence the perceptions, motives, and behavior of others.

examples.text: Conspiracy theorists claimed that the recent media campaign was merely a government <w>psyop</w> designed to distract the public.
The military conducted a sophisticated <w>psyop</w> to undermine enemy morale before launching the ground offensive.

senses.sense_definition: A psychological operative; an operative or agent who participates in psychological warfare or manipulation campaigns.

examples.text: Intelligence officials suspected the foreign agent was a trained <w>psyop</w> sent to manipulate online discourse.
He served as a military <w>psyop</w> during the conflict, spreading strategic disinformation behind enemy lines.
